name: vue-microfrontends
description: Sistema de gestão empresarial construído com microfrontends em Vue 3, Module Federation e monorepo via npm workspaces.

scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w @vue-mf/dashboard && npm run build -w @vue-mf/customers && npm run build -w @vue-mf/sales && npm run build -w @vue-mf/settings
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -k -n dashboard,customers,sales,settings -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run preview -w @vue-mf/dashboard" "npm run preview -w @vue-mf/customers" "npm run preview -w @vue-mf/sales" "npm run preview -w @vue-mf/settings"
